name: Haran
modernContext: Near Harran in southeastern Turkey, close to the modern Turkey-Syria border.
description: A city where Abram lived before entering Canaan.

name: Shechem
modernContext: Usually associated with the area of modern Nablus in the West Bank.
description: A city in the central hill country of Canaan.

name: Bethel
modernContext: Often associated with the area near modern Beitin in the central West Bank.
description: A site west of Ai where Abram pitched his tent.

name: Ai
modernContext: Commonly associated with sites east of Bethel in the central West Bank region.
description: A place east of Bethel in the hill country.

name: Horeb
modernContext: Associated with the Sinai / northwest Arabia discussion in the Exodus geography tradition.
description: The mountain region connected with Moses in Exodus 3.

name: Midian
modernContext: Generally connected with northwest Arabia, east of the Gulf of Aqaba.
description: The region where Moses lives before returning to Egypt.

name: Egypt
modernContext: The Nile Valley in modern Egypt.
description: The land where Israel is living at the beginning of Exodus.

name: Galilee
modernContext: Northern Israel around the Sea of Galilee.
description: Northern region connected with much of Jesus' public ministry.

name: Capernaum
modernContext: On the northwest shore of the Sea of Galilee in modern Israel.
description: A town by the Sea of Galilee.

name: Jordan
modernContext: The Jordan River valley between modern Israel, the West Bank, and Jordan.
description: River valley associated with several Gospel scenes.

name: Jerusalem
modernContext: Jerusalem in the central hill country.
description: The city from which Saul begins his journey toward Damascus.

name: Damascus
modernContext: Damascus, the capital city of modern Syria.
description: A Syrian city connected with Saul and Ananias in Acts 9.
